headline_item.title_zh: Google 通过 Gemini Decision 1 加入决策模型浪潮，单次得分 1,000 个问题
headline_item.title_en: Google joins the decision-model wave with Gemini Decision 1, scoring 1,000 questions in a single pass
headline_item.event_summary_zh: Google Deepmind 正在推出 Gemini Decisions API，这是一个为快速、封闭式决策（例如是/否问题、多项选择和基于量表的评分）而构建的界面。底层模型 Gemini Decision 1 可一次性处理多达 1,000 个独立问题，涉及文本、图像、音频、视频和 PDF
headline_item.event_summary_en: Google Deepmind is introducing the Gemini Decisions API, an interface built for fast, closed-ended decisions like yes/no questions, multiple choice, and scale-based ratings. The underlying model, Gemini Decision 1, processes up to 1,000 independent questions in a single pass across text, images, audio, video, and PDFs. It scores options directly and returns probabilities with confidence values in 150 to 250 milliseconds. Google says it already uses the API internally for dynamic model routing in

【起因与机理】降低开发者微调与工程落地的门槛与算力开销，加速端到端应用在真实业务中生根发芽。
【关键数据与实测】Google 通过 Gemini Decision 1 加入决策模型浪潮，单次得分 1,000 个问题。
【观点态度】美国证券交易委员会 (SEC)在全球大模型开源社区与技术研发一线。

headlines.title_en: US corporate AI spending hits a new high in October, but growth slows to 1.65 percent
headlines.event_summary_zh: 美国企业人工智能支出在 2026 年 10 月创下新高，但增长幅度不大。 Ramp AI 指数跟踪金融服务提供商 Ramp 的企业客户的 AI 支出，该指数显示环比增长 1.65%。 Ramp 表示，最常使用人工智能的用户花费更多
headlines.event_summary_en:
US corporate AI spending hit a new high in October 2026, but growth was modest.

The Ramp AI Index, which tracks AI spending among business customers of financial services provider Ramp, showed a 1.65 percent increase month over month.

The heaviest AI users spent somewhat more, according to Ramp. The top one percent of companies by AI spending paid a median of $10,200 per employee per month, up nine percent. A typical company, by contrast, spent just $16.32, a slight increase of less than a dol

So, patience my friend.

titans.event_context_zh:
人们应该始终掌控未来。

OpenAI 反对这样一种观念，即人们被降级到做“人工智能系统认为对人类有意义的奖励”的事情是可以接受的。

人们不应该将对未来的控制权交给超级智能，而这一要求最终应该限制人工智能的进步。

titans.quote_zh:
人们应该始终掌控未来。

OpenAI 反对这样一种观念，即人们被降级到做“人工智能系统认为对人类有意义的奖励”的事情是可以接受的。

titans.quote_en:
People should always be in control of the future.

OpenAI is against the notion that it would be acceptable for people to be relegated to a role of doing things that “AI systems think makes sense to reward in humans”.

People should not cede control of the future to superintelligence, and that requirement should ultimately constrain AI progress.
